The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kao Cen Darach]] owned a '''green-bladed''' '''lightsaber''' during the [[Battle of Korriban]]. He wielded his lightsaber when he fought the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Vindican and manage to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw his lightsaber]] to save Satele from [[Darth Malgus]]'s killing blow.<ref name="Return" />

When [[Jace Malcom]] called for them to join him, Darach informed his apprentice to flee while he remained behind to hold off the Sith. As her master ran into the fray Shan threw her [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] to him, which Darach used [[Jar'Kai/Legends|simultaneously]] with his own lightsaber to continue the battle, giving more time for her escape.<ref name="Return" />

[[File:Jedi_Master_versus_two_Sith.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darach wielding his and Satele's lightsabers against Vindican and Malgus]]
Despite being outnumbered, Darach proved to be an even match for Vindican and Malgus, even managing to [[Shiak|mortally wound]] Vindican. Malgus seized the opportunity to force [[Vindican's lightsaber]] from hands and reciprocate his opponent's usage of three blades to re-engage the Jedi Master and managed to kill Darach.<ref name="Return" />
